headline: Bangladesh eliminated from Women's Asia Cup after 40-run loss to India in semi-final
summary: India set a target of 150 runs, and Bangladesh were bowled out for 109 in the first semi-final. The team's batting struggled, with only two players reaching double digits.
details: Bangladesh has been eliminated from the Women's Asia Cup after a 40-run defeat to India in the first semi-final. India posted 149/6 in their 20 overs, and Bangladesh could only manage 109/7 in reply.

India batted first after Bangladesh won the toss and chose to field. Smriti Mandhana fell early, but Shefali Verma and Pratika Rawal built a crucial 50-run partnership. Verma went on to score a half-century, finishing with 64 runs.
Captain Harmanpreet Kaur provided valuable support with an unbeaten 24, aided by cameos from Richa Ghosh and Deepti Sharma, setting Bangladesh a challenging target of 150.

In response, Bangladesh had a decent opening partnership of 26 runs, but no other significant contributions followed. Dilara Akter (21) and Swarna Akter (22 not out) were the only batters to reach double figures, ultimately falling short of the target.
caption:
Bangladesh's Women's Asia Cup campaign ends in the semi-finals after a 40-run loss to India.
Missed catches and slow batting plagued the team's chase.

headline_marked: Apple unveils [[first foldable iPhone Duo]] starting at $1,999
headline: Apple unveils first foldable iPhone Duo starting at $1,999
summary: New CEO John Ternus debuts the foldable device, combining smartphone portability with a tablet-like display to challenge Samsung and Chinese rivals.
details: Apple has officially unveiled the iPhone Duo, its first-ever foldable smartphone, starting at $1,999. The device is designed to be passport-shaped when folded, combining the portability of a phone with the larger screen of a tablet.

The iPhone Duo features a full external display for quick access when closed and a larger internal display when open. Apple claims to have significantly reduced the visible crease in the middle of the screen, a common criticism of foldable technology.

The launch marks the first major event under new CEO John Ternus, who took over from Tim Cook on September 1. Ternus, a 5_1-year-old former product design lead, is tasked with delivering a breakout hit for the company.
Alongside the Duo, Apple announced the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, priced at $1,199 and $1,299 respectively. These models feature improved cameras with adjustable lens apertures.
The market for foldables remains small, making up less than 2% of global shipments. However, research firm IDC expects Apple to capture about a third of thedemand with the Duo's entry.

The release comes amid a supply chain crunch caused by the AI boom, which has pushed prices higher across the industry. Smartphone shipments are expected to decline by over 16% this year while average costs jump by 27%.
